lol.headline: This patch focuses on diversifying ADC power levels and adjusting tank/bruiser utility while refining several mage kits.

A widespread series of buffs to diverse roles, paired with targeted nerfs to specific powerhouses like Nasus and Ryze.
The patch focuses on shifting AP carries toward higher scaling while curbing the dominance of certain utility and burst champions.
